newsitem.title: UK: Euro jet narrowly weaker amid very quiet day.
newsitem.headline: Euro jet narrowly weaker amid very quiet day.

text.p: European jet fuel was a touch easier on Thursday in line with narrowly weaker futures. Trade was very quiet as most of Europe observed public holidays.
May IPE gas oil closed 75 cents weaker at $171 a tonne.

Activity was mostly confined to talk with cargoes in NWE around May IPE +$20-22 cif NWE although buying interest was hard to find. Barges were showing some relative strength against cargoes with prices pegged at May IPE gas oil +$19-19.50 fob ARA.

In the Mediterranean difficulties in finding freight and the high cost of transport was persuading buyers to back off. Premiums for EU grade material were talked down to fob high quotes +$6-8 while Libyan was under greater pressure.
"Contract holders had to pay a firm price for the material so are reluctant to let it go at too low a price," said one trader.
Ras Lanuf was pegged around fob high quotes +$5, but Zawia product was unlikely to attract more than about fob high quotes +$3.
